title: CCPA order dated 10 Nov 2026 (Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare, Commissioner Anupam Mishra; case CCPA-2/55/2025-CCPA) fines ANI Technologies (Ola) ₹10 lakh over pre-acceptance add-on/tip prompts such as 'Improve your chances of quicker ride confirmation!'; held a misleading advertisement and a dark pattern; prompts to stop forthwith on every Ola platform, compliance report within 15 days; Ola's own data showed add-on requests were accepted less often (no figures used: order and Bar & Bench disagree); suggested amounts started at ₹10–₹40 and were later raised; Ola argued add-on optional, all to driver, used for less viable rides; Rapido fined ₹10 lakh in Sept 2026; National Consumer Helpline 1915 / 1800-11-4000
